nodes.label: Ideal audiences
nodes.text: Pau’s sessions serve college students, fresh graduates, aspiring freelancers, virtual assistants, career shifters, entrepreneurs, church communities, youth organizations, and corporate teams exploring freelancing or digital skills.

nodes.label: Participant support
nodes.text: Participants receive access to a free coaching session to ask questions, seek guidance, and receive practical advice as they begin or continue their freelancing journey. A duration, scheduling policy, booking link, and unlimited access have not been provided. Contact Pau to discuss the arrangement; this is not an instant public booking service.

nodes.label: Invite Pau
nodes.text: To invite Pau, use the inquiry form in the contact section, email askspeakerpau@gmail.com, or call 09153412728. Helpful details are your name, organization, inquiry type, topic, event type, preferred date, location or online platform, audience, and event goals. A submitted inquiry receives a reference ID; it does not confirm availability or a booking. Pau confirms availability, fees, and event arrangements directly. This assistant cannot book or send an inquiry for you.

nodes.label: Upcoming events
nodes.text: The website lists Freelance 101: Start Your Freelancing Journey with Confidence. It is a sample listing that shows how events will be published, not a confirmed session. It is for students, fresh graduates, career shifters, and beginners exploring freelancing. Takeaways include: understand how freelancing works, identify a niche that suits you, build confidence in starting your freelance journey, take clear next steps toward becoming a freelancer. Its date, time, format and venue are to be announced. No fee, capacity, or certificate has been announced.

nodes.label: Her experience
nodes.text: Pau began as a Marketing Assistant at a corporate company in the Philippines, organizing corporate events and collaborating with teams. After experiencing burnout and wanting more room to grow, she applied as a Virtual Assistant during the pandemic. She started without experience or a roadmap and learned through trial and error. Her first client helped her feel valued, build confidence, work with multiple clients, and develop her skills. She has navigated difficult clients, multiple accounts, and workdays sometimes beyond 14 hours.

nodes.label: Session formats
nodes.text: Available session formats listed in the portfolio are keynote speaking, workshops, seminars, webinars, panel discussions, coaching sessions, and Q&A. Fees, dates, session lengths, event capacity, and travel availability must be confirmed directly with Pau.

nodes.label: Freelance 101
nodes.text: Freelance 101 is for students, career shifters, and beginners. It covers what freelancing really is, different freelance careers, finding your niche, preparing your portfolio, getting your first client, and common mistakes beginners make.

nodes.label: Inspirational Leadership
nodes.text: Inspirational Leadership is for students, young professionals, leaders, church communities, and organizations. It covers leading with purpose and integrity, building influence beyond a title, developing a growth mindset, overcoming setbacks and embracing challenges, leading yourself before leading others, character, resilience and service, and turning experiences into opportunities to inspire others.

nodes.label: Social Media Marketing
nodes.text: Social Media Marketing covers the fundamentals of social media marketing, creating engaging content, content planning, building a personal brand, understanding clients, and working with businesses.

nodes.label: Mentoring & Cross Core
nodes.text: As opportunities grew beyond what she could personally take on, Pau began mentoring close friends who asked how to start freelancing. This became a passion for helping others build meaningful careers. She now leads Cross Core, a digital marketing agency built to create opportunities, equip aspiring freelancers with practical skills, and help others grow alongside her.

nodes.label: Participant outcomes
nodes.text: Participants will learn how freelancing works, identify a niche that suits them, learn practical social media marketing fundamentals, build confidence in starting a freelance journey, understand how branding creates opportunities, and take clear next steps toward becoming a freelancer. Jobs, clients, income, and career success are not guaranteed.

nodes.label: Meet Pau
nodes.text: Pau Vicente is a speaker, freelance coach, and social media marketing & branding strategist. Her message is ‘Lead with Love. Grow with Purpose.’ She helps aspiring freelancers build with confidence.

nodes.label: Registration
nodes.text: Registration on the event page is a preview only. Visitors can try the form, but no seat is reserved and nothing is sent or saved. Registration will open on the event page when a real session is confirmed. Visitors can contact Pau with questions.

nodes.label: Public profiles
nodes.text: Pau’s public profiles are Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/paulinemelissar.v/ ; LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pauline-vicente-b86849234/ ; Instagram: @pau.melissaa at https://www.instagram.com/pau.melissaa/ .

nodes.label: Why invite Pau
nodes.text: Pau brings real-world freelancing experience, practical strategies, meaningful stories that inspire action, and clear explanations of complex concepts. Her speaking style combines practical strategies with real-life experiences in an encouraging learning environment. She supports knowledge, confidence, continuous growth, the right mindset, and purposeful next steps.
